en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a coastal village seen across a bay. In the foreground are rocky, low vegetation‑covered shores. Across the water lies a compact settlement of wooden houses and boathouses, with several small sailing boats and rowboats moored in the harbor. A prominent church with a tall steeple stands on a rocky rise to the left. In the distance, a windmill and more clustered houses are visible. The word "FISKEBÄCKSKIL" is printed in white in the lower left corner, and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 6638 appears in the lower right.
